headline: Africa makes digital payments almost free. And taxes them in the same move
summary: African states are investing in shared payment infrastructure to lower transaction costs, but several also tax those transactions. The article cites a documented risk that the most modest users revert to cash, and a recent debate in Nigeria.
why: Transaction taxes and payment infrastructure costs shape the economics of mobile money and fintech firms, which are major growth drivers in many African markets.
original_headline: L’Afrique rend les paiements numériques presque gratuits. Et les taxe dans le même mouvement
